newsitem.title: ROMANIA: ROMANIAN CUSTOMS OFFICERS IN HEROIN HAUL.
newsitem.headline: ROMANIAN CUSTOMS OFFICERS IN HEROIN HAUL.

text.p: Romanian customs officers on Wednesday seized 3.2 kg (7 pounds) of heroin worth some $640,000 on the local market and arrested an unnamed Turkish citizen, a customs statement said.
It said the drugs were smuggled in from Turkey, via neighbouring Bulgaria, hidden inside a car and were captured at the Giurgiu border crossing, on the River Danube.

The statement did not specify the destination of the transport but police believe most drugs in the country are in transit on the "Balkan route" to Western Europe, as domestic consumption is still low. REUTER
